mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the source of love which you must emulate."
The Bible is the source of love which you must emulate.

Faith is a proclamation of belief in the existence of Allah and the teachings of Prophet Muhammad (Peace be on Him).

God is the creator: - He brought you into being.

The Holy Bible is the name given to their scriptures and its opening chapter has the affirmation of God as the creator.

Sharia is an Arabic word that means "the path to be followed".

Eros is a Greek word used for a kind of love among people.
